text.p: Follwing are some of the leading storied in Norwegian papers this morning:
- Shipping company Belship ASA is buying 60 percent of British company Gibson Gas Tankers, which owns five gas tankers. Gibson has an estimated net value of $28 million.
- The Oslo Bourse and the Insurance and Securities Commission is to investigate international software house Sysdeco ASA. During the last eigth months Sysdeco's share price has fallen 90 percent.
- Norwegian soccer league champio's Rosenborg lost 0-1 to Portugal's Porto in a European Champion's League Cup Group D match on Wednesday. Porto scored the winning goal in the 90th minute.

- ABB Norwegian subsidy ABB-Environment AS will sign a contract on Friday worth 100 million crowns with Chinese power producer Shenzhen Energy. ABB will design and deliver a large sulphur pollution control unit.

- Local authorities in Oslo want to sell 20 percent of Norway's largest power producer Oslo Energi. The sale is dependent on the approval of Energy Minister Jens Stoltenberg. A 20 percent stake of Oslo Energy is estimated to be worth three billion crowns.
